snippet.title: Pokémon Infinite Fusion 2: Hoenn - EARLY ACCESS TRAILER
snippet.description:
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/infinitefusion

Part 1 of the game will be available from June 12th 2026. Make sure to join the Discord to download it. Do not download from anywhere else.

Also, check out this FAQ if you have questions: https://hackmd.io/@PIF-Staff/PIF-Hoenn-FAQ

Make sure to subscribe to this channel and join the discord for more news about Infinite fusion and Infinite Fusion 2!


This is a non-profit fan-made game. No copyright infringements intended.
Please support the official games!
